title: Two process runs taking the same backlog id turned promptctl validate red for every later PR until someone renumbered
problem: Backlog ids are 'the next free number' with no remote claim. Two process runs filed P075 in parallel; each PR validated alone and both merged, so main held two P075 files and the duplicate-id check failed prompts-ci on every later PR (nearly every PR carries a run record under prompts/). Runs then renumbered in their own PRs, raced each other, and one rename was dropped at merge.
evidence: grep -l -E 'id P075 is also|P075.*(validate|collid|duplicate)|(validate|collid|duplicate).*P075' prompts/runs/*.json: 9 run records, all 2026-11-25
platform/ci/friction_rank.py --live --ungated --days 2 (2026-11-25): #8 prompts/process/backlog/ 3x and #17 prompts/process/backlog/README.md 2x, both this collision
change: validate fails on a duplicate id only when the change adds one of the files; a duplicate whose files are all already on the base branch (the PR merge commit's first parent in CI, origin/main locally) is a warning, and `promptctl backlog` prints it under 'Fix first' for the next process run. On main itself it stays an error, so main_health still shows it. prompts-ci.yml checks out depth 2 so the base parent exists. A remote claim (security_next-style claim branches) was considered and not taken: it adds a branch per item and a push outside the session's work branch, for a race seen once.
metric: run records whose friction or errors name a backlog-id collision failing an unrelated PR's validate
